BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced that during the period of March 16 to March 20, 2026, it purchased a total of 1,000,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £50 million share repurchase program. The purchases were executed on the London Stock Exchange with the highest price paid per share being 295.2000 pence and the lowest at 257.0000 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 280.80 pence across these transactions. Following these purchases, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,417,196,582, with a total of 1,417,196,582 voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 23 March 2026 23 March 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the ""Company"", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 16 March 2026 to 20 March 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregated volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price (pence) Trading venue 16 March 2026 225,000 291.3000 285.1000 288.1854 LSE 17 March 2026 225,000 291.2000 282.6000 288.0053 LSE 18 March 2026 225,000 295.2000 285.5000 290.3890 LSE 19 March 2026 30,000 281.9000 278.4000 280.1714 LSE 20 March 2026 250,000 269.3000 257.0000 262.8251 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 8,430,000 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from UBS in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,418,196,582 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,418,196,582.
